# ZORRI

> ZORRI (ZORRI S.R.L., Bucharest, Romania) is a studio at the intersection of AI systems design, B2B marketing and strategy. Tagline: "Ideas, made happen." It takes clients from idea to live system in three steps — Research (market research, competitive intelligence, pay transparency, EU funding); AI orchestration (pipelines, evaluation, governance); Strategy & go-to-market (strategy, consultancy, advisory, positioning, launch) — and runs its own product, ReLoop.me. Founder: Ligia Adam. Contact: hello@zorri.ro. Fixed-scope offers, quoted per project.

Company: ZORRI S.R.L. · CUI 55137499 · Trade register J2026042991009 · EUID ROONRC.J2026042991009 · EU PIC 860469832 · not a VAT payer (no VAT added). Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. Serves clients across the European Union, in English and Romanian.

## Practices

- [Research](https://zorri.ro/research): market and competitor analysis, labour-market and pay intelligence, EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 readiness, EU and national funding eligibility and applications, expert calls, business consultancy and training. Not legal advice.
- [AI orchestration](https://zorri.ro/ai-systems): AI orchestration (LLM workflows, n8n, integrations), custom software and data infrastructure, evaluation and QA of AI outputs (repeat-run, regression, adversarial testing), AI governance (EU AI Act incl. Annex III, Art. 25 provider/deployer boundaries, auditability), GDPR-aware data design, adoption training, ready-made automations.
- [Strategy & go-to-market](https://zorri.ro/go-to-market): strategy, management consultancy and advisory, positioning and category design, messaging, industry analyst relations, customer references, PR, demand generation, SEO and GEO (AI search visibility), for AI and B2B technology companies.

## All offers ([services](https://zorri.ro/services))

- Advisory Hour — per hour: One hour on an AI build, a governance question, a funding call or a go-to-market decision, with written notes after. [All practices]
- Expert Call — per hour: Expert input on AI products, HR tech and skills-based hiring, EU pay transparency, B2B tech go-to-market and the CEE market. [Research]
- Job-Ad Pay Transparency Check — up to 3 job ads: Up to three job ads read against Directive (EU) 2023/970: what is missing, what reads as biased, and a corrected version. [Research]
- Funding Eligibility Check — per call: A senior consultant reads the call against your company and project, then gives you a yes or no with the reasons, the gaps and what it would take. [Research]
- AI Search Visibility Audit — per website: How ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI answers describe your company today, and the fixes: structured data, llms.txt, content and category language. [Strategy & GTM]
- Talk or Training Session — per session: A talk or hands-on session on AI orchestration, AI governance, EU pay transparency or B2B go-to-market. [All practices]
- AI Workflow Audit — per workflow: An existing AI workflow tested for consistency and failure modes: repeat-run tests, edge cases, where it can ship a wrong answer, and what to fix first. [AI orchestration]
- AI Adoption Workshop — half day or full day: Where AI helps in your workflows, what to automate first, what not to trust, and a 30-day plan. [AI orchestration]
- Positioning Workshop — one day: A one-day working session that ends with a positioning statement, category choice and messaging your team agrees on. [Strategy & GTM]
- AI Governance Review — per system: An AI system mapped against the EU AI Act and GDPR: risk classification, provider or deployer role, documentation gaps and what to fix first. Not legal advice. [AI orchestration]
- Research Brief — per question: One market, labour-market or competitor question, owned by a senior researcher who checks every source and signs off the written brief. [Research]
- Analyst Relations Readiness — per programme: The analysts who matter for your category, what they expect, and briefing materials ready for the first conversations. [Strategy & GTM]
- Pay Transparency Readiness Sprint — 2 weeks: A named lead audits up to 15 job ads and the pay practice behind them, writes a pay-range justification per role and a gap list against Directive (EU) 2023/970, and walks your team through it. Not legal advice. [Research]
- AI Orchestration Sprint — 2 weeks: One production AI workflow with versioned prompts, schema-checked output and a quality gate that fails closed, plus documentation and handover. [AI orchestration]
- Fractional CMO — per month, 4 days: Four days a month owning positioning, analyst relations, demand generation or launches alongside your team. [Strategy & GTM]
- GTM Sprint — 2–4 weeks: Positioning and messaging, a category and competitor map, a pricing and channel plan, and a launch plan. [Strategy & GTM]
- External Project Management — monthly retainer: Ongoing project management and hand-holding across research, AI builds and launches: planning, vendors, weekly check-ins and reporting. [All practices]
- Funding Application Support — scoped per call: One responsible lead takes your application from eligibility to a file ready to submit: project design, work plan, budget logic and indicators. No outcome is guaranteed. [Research]
- Ready-made AI Automations — licensed per company: AI automations for recurring tasks, such as building accounting or stock documents from a spreadsheet, licensed and set up for your company. [AI orchestration]
- Funding support — scoped per call or round: From EU projects and grants to investor decks: we find the right money, check you can get it, and build the case. [Research]
- Market and competitive intelligence — per question or 2–4 weeks: Who your buyers are, who you're up against and what makes you hard to replace, researched for insight and opportunity. [Research]
- Capability intelligence — per project or via ReLoop.me: Our niche, built on ReLoop.me: a neutral read of professional capability in CVs and job descriptions, for skills-based hiring and nonlinear careers. [Research]
- Moat and Market Position Research — 2–4 weeks: A senior strategist maps where you stand against competitors and substitutes, tests what your advantage really rests on, and shows you how to deepen it. [Research]
- AI Opportunity Assessment — 1–2 weeks: A structured look across your operations to find, size and prioritise the workflows worth automating first. [AI orchestration]
- Product Launch Programme — 6–12 weeks: Research, positioning, product marketing and launch execution in one engagement, run with your team. [Strategy & GTM]

## Product

- [ReLoop.me](https://reloop.me): capability intelligence for nonlinear careers and skills-based hiring, built and operated by ZORRI. Role Intel reads a job description; Profile Intel reads a CV. Role Intel API for job boards and HR platforms.

## People

- [Ligia Adam](https://zorri.ro/about), founder: 15+ years in B2B technology go-to-market (Bitdefender analyst relations and global enterprise marketing, Lenovo country marketing, Digital Nation head of marketing), co-founder of CivicTech Romania, GovITHub fellow, builder of ReLoop.me. Forbes 30 Under 30 Romania 2018 (CivicTech Romania team). https://www.linkedin.com/in/ligiaadam

   Working with ZORRI

   How do I start?

   Email a few lines about what you need, or the name of a service. You get a reply within 2 working days and a free 30-minute call, then a written scope and quote. Work starts once you confirm.

   How is an engagement quoted?

   Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

   Can we start small?

   Yes. Many projects start with a focused engagement, such as an audit or a research brief, and continue into a sprint or an ongoing partnership once the scope is clear.

   Is the governance and pay transparency work legal advice?

   No. It is operational readiness: classification, gaps and what to fix. Where you need a legal opinion, we work alongside your lawyers.

   Do you work outside Romania?

   Yes. ZORRI works with clients across the European Union, in English and Romanian, remotely or in person, based on availability.

  Not sure what you need?

  Start with a conversation. We'll help find the problem and the right next step.

  Email us

# https://zorri.ro/ai-systems

Practice

  AI orchestration

  From AI agents to deterministic workflows.

  We build AI agents, pipelines, automation and custom software, from autonomous agents where judgement helps to deterministic workflows where every run must match. Every step is versioned, every output checked, every decision traceable. Then we map them against the EU AI Act and GDPR, so they can be defended as well as used.

   AI that holds up under scrutiny

  An agent or a workflow holds up under scrutiny when it behaves predictably within the limits you set, stops itself when an output fails a check, and leaves a record of why. Where you need the same answer to the same input every time, we make it deterministic. That is engineering and governance together, and it is what this practice delivers.

   What this covers

  AI agents, pipelines and automationAI agents, LLM workflows, n8n orchestration and integrations
Custom software and dataPortals, data infrastructure and hosted digital assets
Evaluation and quality assuranceRepeat-run, regression and adversarial testing of AI outputs
AI governanceEU AI Act classification, Art. 25 boundaries, auditability and provenance
Data protection by designGDPR-aware retention, deletion and access
Adoption and trainingWorkshops, talks and capability building for teams

   Fixed-scope offers

    Advisory Hour

    per hour

    For a founder or team with one sharp question.

    60-minute video call
Written notes and next steps within a day

    Talk or Training Session

    per session

    For teams, conferences and programmes.

    Up to 90 minutes
Slides and materials to keep

    AI Workflow Audit

    per workflow

    For teams already running an AI or n8n workflow.

    Repeat-run consistency test
Failure-mode map
A prioritised fix list

    AI Adoption Workshop

    half day or full day

    For a team of up to 15.

    Where AI helps
What to automate first
What not to trust
A 30-day plan

    AI Governance Review

    per system

    For teams putting an AI system or use case into production.

    Risk classification, including Annex III
Your role and where Art. 25 could change it

    AI Orchestration Sprint

    2 weeks

    For one production AI workflow, built end to end.

    Versioned prompts, so every change can be traced

A quality gate that fails closed: an output that fails a check is not sent
Documentation and handover

    External Project Management

    monthly retainer

    For teams that want the work steered, not just delivered.

    Weekly planning and check-ins
Vendor and freelancer coordination
Progress reporting to founders or the board

    Ready-made AI Automations

    licensed per company

    For companies with recurring back-office paperwork.

    Set-up in your tools
Checks before anything is issued
Licence per company

    AI Opportunity Assessment

    1–2 weeks

    For companies that know AI could help, but not where to start.

    Interviews with the people who run the work
A map of candidate workflows, scored for value and risk
A prioritised shortlist and the first build to start

  Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

   Questions

   What is AI orchestration?

   AI orchestration is the design of a workflow in which one or more AI models, data sources and tools run in a defined order, with checks between the steps. The goal is output you can trust and trace, not a single clever prompt.

   What does “fails closed” mean?

   If an output does not pass its checks, the workflow stops instead of passing it on. A wrong answer is held back rather than shipped.

   Is the AI Governance Review legal advice?

   No. It is a technical and operational review: risk classification, your role under the EU AI Act, documentation gaps and design fixes. Your lawyer can work from it.

   Which tools do you build with?

   Large language models (including the Claude API), n8n for orchestration, and integrations with the systems you already use. The choice is agreed during scoping.

   How is an engagement quoted?

   Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

  Have an AI system in mind?

  Describe what it should do, where its inputs come from and who relies on its output. You'll get questions back, or a scope.

  Email us

Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

   Questions

   What is market intelligence?

   Market intelligence is structured evidence about a market — buyers, competitors, prices, labour and regulation — collected and analysed so a decision can be made on it. We deliver it as a written brief with its sources.

   Is pay transparency work legal advice?

   No. We prepare the operational material: audited job ads, written pay-range reasoning and a gap list against Directive (EU) 2023/970. Your lawyer or HR counsel can work from it.

   Do you guarantee that a funding application wins?

   No. Funding decisions belong to the evaluators. We make sure the application is eligible, coherent, complete and on time.

   Which funding programmes do you work with?

   EU programmes (such as Horizon Europe, the EIC and Digital Europe) and Romanian programmes financed from EU funds. Eligibility is checked against the specific call before any work starts.

   How is an engagement quoted?

   Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

  Need evidence before a decision?

  Tell us the decision and the deadline. You'll get a scope and a date for the readout.

  Email us

# https://zorri.ro/go-to-market

Practice

  Strategy & Go-To-Market

  Own a position that's hard to copy.

  Positioning, analyst relations and launches for AI and B2B technology companies, run by someone who has done this work for more than fifteen years.

   Making complex products legible

  Technical products rarely fail for lack of capability. They fail because buyers can't tell what they are or why they matter. This practice makes the product legible: a category it belongs to, a position it can defend, and proof buyers trust.

   Questions

   What is go-to-market strategy?

   Go-to-market strategy is the plan for how a product reaches and wins its buyers: who they are, what problem it solves for them, how it is positioned and priced, and which channels carry it.

   What is GEO?

   GEO, generative engine optimisation, is the work of making sure AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI answers find, understand and correctly describe your company.

   Who does the work?

   Ligia Adam: more than 15 years in B2B technology go-to-market, including global enterprise marketing and analyst relations at Bitdefender and country marketing at Lenovo.

   How is an engagement quoted?

   Every engagement is scoped and quoted in writing before work starts. ZORRI is not a VAT payer, so quotes are final, with no VAT added.

# https://zorri.ro/about

About ZORRI

  Why ZORRI

  The distance between an idea and a working business is rarely just technical. It takes the right insights, owned choices and sturdy systems that can carry the vision forward. ZORRI helps you close that distance.

   We know the gap. We've been there.

   We've sat on your side of the table, so we know what you need: plug-and-play senior professionals who step into your idea and get the work done. That's what we offer.

   We roll up our sleeves and help you:

    process research into decisions you can act on

    turn strategy into working operations

    take AI experiments into production

    turn a working product into a story the market buys

    swap separate collaborators for one team you manage once

   Story · Strategy · Systems

   Our process, our focus.

   StorySee the bigger picture.
Every project starts with the people, the market and the problem. We question assumptions and find the signal in the noise.

   StrategyEmpower your idea.
We connect evidence, business priorities and what is technically possible into a direction you can actually pursue.

   SystemsMake things happen.
Ideas become valuable when they work in practice. We build, orchestrate and improve the systems that turn decisions into outcomes.
